newsitem.title: PERU: Peru central bank offers 60 mln soles 28-day CDs.
newsitem.headline: Peru central bank offers 60 mln soles 28-day CDs.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru announced Tuesday an auction of Certificates of Deposit (CDs), saying it would accept bids for 28-day CDs worth 60 million soles until 1430 local time/1930 GMT.
All the certificates have a July 9 starting date.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates, which will be announced after the auction, is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
